svg.title: Twisted Lattice Product Formula — A Twist for Each Prime
svg.desc: Editorial mathematical monograph schematic of New.TwistedLattice.covolume_add_index_nonneg ("a twist for each prime"). Top source box shows the basis w = Sum.elim y z of V (dimension n + n'): n short nearly-integral vectors y_1,...,y_n with CovolumeLe y c and IndexLe y delta, adjoined with n' completion vectors z_1,...,z_{n'} satisfying normSqAt (z_i) sigma <= exp(b_short) and nonzero denominator scalars gamma(xi). Left column shows the Archimedean place (infinity) using the trivial twist Theta_1 = L.lift 1 into Space 1 with rational positive-definite gramMatrix G in M(Q), combining Hadamard (covolumeLe_of_normSqAt_le), Fischer (CovolumeLe.sumElim), and Galois conjugate bounds (CovolumeLe.norm_map_det_gram_le) to obtain ||sigma(Gram(1))|| <= exp(c + n' * b_short) for all sigma in Aut(C). Right column shows finite primes (iota | l) choosing a different allowed twist xi_iota = theta(iota) per prime across parallel prime lanes (iota_1 | l_1, iota_2 | l_2, ..., iota | l), paired with a twist-independent clearing matrix u in M_n(O_iota) satisfying iota.Carries u y (integralVectors iota) and its conjugate u' in M_n(O_{iota bar}) via norm_inner_le_one, doubling the index contribution to 2*delta (heightLe_pow_mul_det_gram). Bottom convergence panel displays the exact three-factor identity collapsing prime-varying pieces back to constant Gram(1): Gram(1) = [|gamma(xi_iota)|^(2n') * Gram(xi_iota)] * [|gamma(xi_iota)|^(-2)]^(n') * [Z(1) / Z(xi_iota)], with explicit height badges HeightLe (2*delta) for index (both u and u'), HeightLe (n' * b_denom) for completion denominators, and HeightLe (b_volume) for volume ratio Z(1)/Z(xi_iota). Finally, a single nonzero global multiplier H and the rational log_product_formula (log|q| + sum log|q|_l = 0 on q = Norm_{Q(H)/Q}(H)) close the headline inequality: 0 <= c + 2*delta + n'(b_short + b_denom) + b_volume.
